description: §21.3 / §21.4 — a cycle closed by `export *` (x.scrml `export * from './y.scrml'`; y.scrml `export * from './x.scrml'`) is a circular import and fires E-IMPORT-002. x.scrml and y.scrml are aux siblings (`files` convention).
rationale: §21.3: "Circular imports SHALL be a compile error (E-IMPORT-002)." `export * from` links its source module like an import (§21.4, ES module semantics), so a star cycle is a cycle in the import graph (S458 review F1).
